name: Inwall super into wall: clip, super into the wall, turn back, clip again
techNote: A 600-tall Ground wall (x -50-50) on a floor, the finish on its top. Jump with your back to the wall, then per loop: release with a light flick toward the wall (-0.4) at Velocity.y under 580 (the wall clip: the turned hitbox's front ground ray starts inside the wall and grounds the dot, refilling the air dash on the Ground-tagged wall), dash into the wall with jump on dash-frame 1 on the next tick (the super off the in-wall ground: 805 up, 876 momentum into the wall, which holds the dot on the wall face while it rises), hold into the wall 2 ticks, turn back (+1, 3 ticks) and rest: facing away with the hitbox's back edge on the wall face, the dot is clip-ready again (WallBehind) and the next flick clips it. Each loop climbs 150 u (clips at y 176, 327, 477) and the grounding gives the dash back every time; the dash's cooldown needs the loop's 12 ticks (a 10-tick loop's dash is refused and the press is a plain clip jump). The last super's momentum carries the dot over the wall's top onto it.
